title: plantago maritima var. gypsicola
intro: Plantago maritima var. gypsicola, commonly known as Sea Plantain, is a coastal plant species within the genus Plantago. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, making it beneficial for health. The therapeutic actions of Sea Plantain include soothing digestive issues, reducing swelling, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
